playstyle: Four flying Nighthaunt spirits with modest Health and dodge saves, relying on Fly and range-two scythes to strike past the front line and glide over obstacles. Their reach weapons carry Critical Grievous, and once Inspired they gain extra damage plus Ensnare and Cleave. Lacking a warscroll of their own, they borrow a generic Death warscroll, gambling on Locus of Shyish buffs or raising slain fighters as vulnerable. The warband wins by picking off isolated foes with precise reach attacks while its slippery ghosts avoid retaliation.
